pattern: D.cls{r, i} = 'EXCLUDED'; D.why{r, i} = [p.stage ':' p.status]; continue
rationale: FC-702/FC-701: the point-status guard is skipped, so the metrics a failed (INFEASIBLE) trim point happens to carry are evaluated as if the point were OK; a failed point then becomes the critical minimum, and an all-infeasible grid gets a Level instead of NOT_ASSESSABLE.

pattern: if isfinite(ru.hi), mHi = (ru.hi - y) / ru.scale; end
replacement: if isfinite(ru.hi), mHi = (y - ru.hi) / ru.scale; end
rationale: A Level-boundary comparison flipped: the upper-bound margin sign is reversed, so a value below a maximum (e.g. tau_R <= 1 s, CAP <= 3.6) reads as a violation and one above it as a pass.
CAP computed with omega_nsp instead of omega_nsp^2: the Control Anticipation Parameter of 3.2.2.1.1 is omega^2/(n/alpha); the error moves every point across the Figure 1-3 lines.
A figure boundary mis-encoded: the Figure 3 Level 1 n/alpha box edge (about 2.7 g/rad) is entered as the Level 2 edge (1.7), widening the Category C Level 1 region.

pattern: a.cn = (s.Cnt_table * a.cnt + a.dcnda * a.dail + a.dcndr * a.drdr) + a.b2v * ((a.cnp * a.p) + (a.cnr * a.r));
replacement: a.cn = (a.cnt + a.dcnda * a.dail + a.dcndr * a.drdr) + a.b2v * ((a.cnp * a.p) + (s.Cnt_table * a.cnr * a.r));
rationale: AeroScale applied to the wrong term: the Cnt_table (formerly Cn_beta) multiplier scales the yaw-damping term cnr instead of the static sideslip table cnt, so the 'Cn_beta x 0.2' mutation would test yaw damping instead of directional stiffness.
